r5-incumbent-no-conjunct.instructions: Does `item.text` touch any of the three things listed in `anchor.scope`: (1) the name of a command or installed entry point; (2) an install script, installer or install path; (3) a script, document, test or workflow that starts, runs or describes the console? Judge whether the item touches at least one of them. Do not judge whether the item obeys `anchor.statement`.

criteria.yes: The item touches a command or entry-point name, an install script, installer or install path, or a script, document, test or workflow that starts, runs or describes the console.
criteria.no: The item touches none of the three: it changes something else, such as a message template, a data model or a review rule.
criteria.unclear: The item text is too vague to tell whether it touches any of the three.

r6-incumbent-any-step.instructions: Does `item.text` touch any of the three things listed in `anchor.scope`: (1) the name of a command or installed entry point; (2) an install script, installer or install path; (3) a script, document, test or workflow that starts, runs or describes the console? Judge whether the item touches at least one of them.
